description: This file contains platform-specific functions for the OpenWrt firmware upgrade process on Octeon-based devices. It includes functions to identify the root filesystem device, copy configuration backups, flash the firmware, and validate upgrade images for different hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from the kernel command line.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the device based on identification.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Chooses the appropriate storage device based on board name and copies configuration backup.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the firmware flashing process, including flashing kernel and root filesystem.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process by identifying the board and invoking the flash function.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for the current device, ensuring necessary files are present and correct.
